## Gauth Unlimited Digital Canvas

Launched this week

An AI tutor on an infinite whiteboard, not a chat thread

Gauth AI Course now runs on an Unlimited Digital Canvas: one continuous whiteboard where lessons unfold spatially instead of in a chat thread or slide deck. Chapters expand side by side as narration plays, board notes write out in sync with the AI voice, and you can zoom from the full concept map down to a single formula. Pause anytime to ask the AI Tutor, and it answers right on the board beneath your step. Generate a canvas lesson on any topic, then export it as a PDF or share a link.

Free

Excited to hunt Gauth Unlimited Digital Canvas today. I hunted Gauth AI Course last month, and this update takes it in a much more visual direction. Instead of another linear chat or slide deck, the whole lesson now unfolds on one continuous canvas. What stood out: - Chapters expand side by side - Notes, visuals, and AI narration stay in sync - Ask the AI Tutor directly inside the lesson - Zoom from the full concept map down to a single formula - Generate, share, or export your own canvas lessons My favorite part is the in-context tutoring: answers stay attached to the exact step you’re working on instead of disappearing into a long chat thread. Worth checking out if you learn better by seeing how ideas connect.

OTPfill — Autofill OTP codes from your email on Mac

  Click into a login code field on any site and OTPfill checks your inbox for mail from the last few minutes, drops the code underneath the box a second or two after it lands, and fills it on its own if the email came from the site you are on. It handles letter codes as well as numbers and ignores promo codes. Safari already does this if you use Apple Mail, and Arsen lives in Gmail and Dia, so it never worked for him. It only reads mail while a code field is open, only recent messages, and stores none of it. Magic links and booking references are next.
